newsitem.title: USA: Madera rescinds Vanity funding pact.
newsitem.headline: Madera rescinds Vanity funding pact.

text.p: Madera International Inc said on Tuesday that it had to rescind the agreement signed with Vanity AVV.
Vanity was committed to fund $5 million dollars by September 10, 1996 and on that day had only funded $250,000, Madera said.
Madera said that it has four candidates in line, one of which will substitute the necessary financing.
Madera also said it is shipping a load of lumber on October 30, 1996 and another shipment with one million dollar revenue by January 1, 1997.
